Default behavior remains nonoverlapping. COMPATIBILITY: Preserve flags, compiled-pattern flag errors, lazy iterator/tuple result types, named/group values and all other operations. QUALITY: Independent overlap/edge/compatibility acceptance, existing tests, strict mypy, Ruff and formatting must pass. Investigate and coordinate related definitions; verify important standard-library API assumptions. No specific implementation is prescribed.

cases.name: text-error-policy
cases.objective: PUBLIC BEHAVIOR: Add explicit keyword errors="strict" to both TextCodec.decode and TextCodec.encode, honoring the standard Python codec error-handling policies including strict, ignore, replace and backslashreplace. COMPATIBILITY: Keep strict defaults, domain exception wrapping and causes, encoding overrides, exact newline/text preservation, source-byte metadata and immutable input models. Unknown handler failures must retain the relevant text domain exception. QUALITY: Independent behavior/compatibility assertions, current tests, strict mypy, Ruff and formatting must pass. Coordinate both method contracts and implementations; verify actual Python API contracts. Multiple implementations are legitimate.

cases.name: regex-whole-string
cases.objective: PUBLIC BEHAVIOR: Add fullmatch_regex(text, pattern, *, flags=0) returning a framework RegexMatch only when the pattern matches the entire string, otherwise None. Export it through the normal devtools.core.regex public API. COMPATIBILITY: Preserve group/named-group and Unicode character spans, empty matches, string/compiled patterns, flags and existing compiled-pattern flag errors. Existing search, replacement and match models remain unchanged. QUALITY: Independent whole-string/public-export/compatibility acceptance, existing tests, strict typing, Ruff and formatting must pass. Investigate and coordinate the authorized files; verify relevant installed API contracts. Do not redesign existing APIs.
